e70c959d-dd6d-4489-a2b7-a98bde2629fc.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: Checkout revision 2 (18:25:51Z) has change_cause 'payment client moved to port 9999'. Its diff from revision 1 is exactly PAYMENT_ADDR 'payment:8080' -> 'payment:9999'.

Checkout's current error is 'dial tcp 10.96.168.114:9999: i/o timeout' on PaymentService/Charge. Checkout returns gRPC Unavailable on PlaceOrder, with five Charge and four PlaceOrder errors in the last 5 minutes.
Payment has one revision (17:39:54Z) and no warning events. Payment logs stop at 18:25:48Z and it has no spans in the last 30 minutes.

Checkout's server 5m error ratio is 0.51 and the 1m ratio is 1.0. Checkout's errors sit almost entirely on the client span PaymentService/Charge (STATUS_CODE_ERROR, about 0.14-0.19/s). Other dependency calls show no errors.
All 18 flagd flags are off. Over 180 minutes the only warnings are unrelated readiness probe failures; there are no restarts or OOM kills.
Payment's server-side Charge error rate is 0 now. Its 5m error ratio peaked at 0.467 around 18:03 and returned to 0 after about 18:20.
Checkout logs no error-level lines in the last 30 minutes. The failure is visible only in traces and info-level logs.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Run 'kubectl get svc payment -n otel-demo -o yaml' and 'kubectl get endpoints payment'. Confirm the ClusterIP is 10.96.168.114 and that port 9999 is not listed.
hypotheses.statement: Payment's Kubernetes Service exposes only port 8080, so 10.96.168.114:9999 has no endpoints and the dial times out.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Run 'kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout -n otel-demo' (or set PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080), then watch service:sli_error_ratio:rate5m for checkout and Charge error spans in Jaeger.
hypotheses.statement: Rolling checkout back to revision 1 will restore Charge calls and drop the 5m error ratio.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check payment pod status and restarts, and payment logs just before 18:25:48Z. Confirm payment's Service selector and endpoints.
hypotheses.statement: Payment stopped receiving traffic at 18:25:48Z, which is just before the checkout change at 18:25:51Z. Payment's last log line may be coincidental or may reflect a separate payment event.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Review payment logs for 17:58-18:03Z and the payment change history for any token or config change in that window.
hypotheses.statement: The earlier payment 'Invalid token' errors for gold-tier users may point to a payment auth or config problem that could return.

inferences.statement: The revision 2 change caused the current outage. The timing matches (about 2m12s before the alert) and the dial target is the 9999 port, which payment does not serve on 8080. The payment-side silence is consistent with no traffic reaching it.
The payment server-side view and checkout's client-side errors disagree only because checkout never reaches payment. Payment being healthy and unreached is the expected pattern for a wrong port.
The earlier 17:58-18:03 error burst (metrics and the payment token warnings) predates the config change and is a separate issue that has already stopped.

root_causes.cause: Revision 2 changed PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999 (payment serves on 8080). Checkout's Charge gRPC dials time out, which fails PlaceOrder with Unavailable and drives the ~37% error ratio. Rolling back to revision 1 should restore service.
Earlier 'Invalid token' errors for gold-tier users (17:58-18:03) caused a past error burst. They stopped on their own and are not the current outage. Still unexplained and worth a follow-up.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout is the victim, and the fault is its own config change. Revision 2 (18:25:51Z, change-cause 'payment client moved to port 9999') set PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Checkout's current errors are gRPC dial timeouts to 10.96.168.114:9999 on PaymentService/Charge, which return Unavailable for PlaceOrder, so about half of checkout requests fail. Payment has no errors because it receives no traffic. Fix: roll checkout back to revision 1 or correct PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:8080, then confirm the 5m error ratio falls. The 17:58-18:03 payment 'Invalid token' burst predates the change and is a separate, already-stopped issue.
